description: Intent i003 (tx-cow-head-realloc, snapshot s01 only) complete. Searched all head-reallocating helper call sites (skb_cow_head 117, skb_cow 41, skb_unclone 18, skb_share_check 49, pskb_expand_head 76, skb_linearize 128 in net/ and drivers/) plus pull variants on TX/edit paths with a capture->realloc->stale-use chain scanner (171 chains; 56 with no refetch on cow/linearize/expand calls), then deep-read the strongest candidates. Four findings written to agent-state/findings/i003.json: (1) s01:net/ipv4/ip_tunnel_core.c:195-241 iptunnel_pmtud_build_icmp() — iph = ip_hdr(skb) captured at 197, then pskb_may_pull(skb, ETH_HLEN+sizeof(iphdr)) at 203, pskb_trim at 210, skb_cow(skb, sizeof(*niph)+sizeof(*icmph)+ETH_HLEN) at 215 (pskb_expand_head frees the old head), stale iph->ttl/.saddr=iph->daddr/.daddr=iph->saddr read at 238/240/241 into the generated ICMP error; reachable from skb_tunnel_check_pmtu() reply paths of geneve/vxlan/bareudp bridged tunnel ports with attacker-controlled inner packet bytes; medium confidence. (2) s01:net/ipv4/ip_tunnel_core.c:288-331 iptunnel_pmtud_build_icmpv6() — same shape: ip6h captured 290, pskb_may_pull 297 / pskb_trim 304 / skb_cow 309, stale ip6h->hop_limit/.saddr=ip6h->daddr/.daddr=ip6h->saddr at 329-331; medium confidence. (3) s01:net/mac80211/tdls.c:2028-2050 ieee80211_process_tdls_channel_switch() — tf = (void *)skb->data at 2029, skb_linearize(skb) at 2039, stale tf->action_code dispatch read at 2045 with no refetch; attacker TDLS frame; medium confidence. (4) s01:drivers/net/wireless/mediatek/mt76/mt7925/mcu.c:493-502 mt7925_mcu_rx_event() — rxd captured 494, skb_linearize 496, rxd->option read 499; firmware-supplied skb, reallocation precondition unproven; low confidence. Safe classifications with explicit evidence: exthdrs.c ipv6_dest_hao 271 / ipv6_rpl_srh_rcv 591 / ipv6_rthdr_rcv 753 (all refetch after pskb_expand_head), net/openvswitch/actions.c:791 and net/sched/sch_frag.c:27 (percpu frag-data struct, not an skb pointer), net/xfrm/xfrm_input.c:307 (cow before pointer capture), net/core/skbuff.c:2270 (sk pointer survives head realloc), net/mac80211/rx.c:2251 (control block; comment documents refetch). Limitations: all findings are static hypotheses — triggering requires a cloned/non-linear skb at the flagged point (pskb_expand_head otherwise a no-op) and no runtime reproducer/KASAN trace was produced; the scanner only catches same-function typed pointer captures so cross-function or arithmetic captures may be missed; arch/, fs/, headers, and macros were not audited; RX-path pskb_may_pull parsers belong to intent i002 and were only covered here on TX/edit paths.
